run_ptb_detokenizer: run the ptb_detokenizer function to clean Penn Treebank tokenized text by fixing contractions and symbols
run_wikitext_detokenizer: run the wikitext_detokenizer function to clean WikiText tokenized text by fixing punctuation, brackets, and contractions
run_lambada_detokenizer: run the lambada_detokenizer function to pass through LAMBADA text without any detokenization changes
run_get_detokenizer: run the get_detokenizer function to look up a detokenizer by dataset name in a file path
review_DETOKENIZERS: review the DETOKENIZERS dictionary mapping dataset names to their corresponding detokenizer functions
